principles.application: Establish the carrier once, then vary its contents or one meaningful property.

principles.application: Let the interface behavior itself supply the microstory; a hand or cursor is not always needed.
principles.exception: Material studies and typography performances have different purposes and need not pretend to be product interactions.

evidence.description: A landscape movie receives a control overlay; a compact photo-menu control changes shape; TV and Safari show compact chrome over rich imagery. This demonstrates a shared rule across apps, rather than a single app task.

On one oblique note surface, the white bottom bar gives way to floating glass controls, those controls regroup, content scrolls under them, and a menu expands and retracts. The stable note plane supports a sequence of related states.
News scrolls beneath its toolbar; a drawing button expands into a tool tray; Maps search sits above the map and a larger library panel. These are three shots in a control-adaptation proof sequence.
The bottom player and navigation change their grouping as the content scrolls, then the broader navigation returns. Content movement is the input to chrome adaptation.

Spotlight expands to files, followed by phone theming, desktop controls, contact cards, window controls and Camera. A rapid feature recap, with an incoming splice and one internal splice made by our edit.
The cover opens and folds into a stand as the device changes orientation. The coherent subject is the cover and its utility, not each view.
A thin laptop profile receives a slow close inspection, the charging connector approaches its edge, and the screen and Dock complete the product demonstration.
The drawer rises over the home screen, pauses, then is inspected closer so its translucency and controls can be read.
Notification Center overlays the home screen; the composition separates into notification, icons and wallpaper planes, then recombines. Physical separation explains a software hierarchy.
The home screen shifts in perspective over a portrait wallpaper; a folder expands and preserves a softened connection to the image beneath it.
A full phone view becomes a closer browser view; scrolling moves content while the bottom toolbar is shown, then makes room for the page.
A landscape phone shows playback controls over the movie, then the controls withdraw and the content carries the frame.
App cards are browsed in the switcher; a message card expands to the full screen, then a text conversation continues. The sequence has a task destination.
One camera interface moves between capture mode, filter grid and a selected treatment, then returns to the home screen. The same coastal composition makes changes comparable.
A full-screen browser view scrolls and exposes the address field and a favorites grid. This is a separately selected source segment; the incoming join is ours.
Artwork, now-playing text and a purchase state are shown close enough to read. A separately selected source segment; the incoming join is ours.
A tiny black dot accompanies typing until the complete question can read, then remains as the central object.

principles.title: Give a material a subject-specific demonstration
principles.observation: Optical edges, leather stitching, reflective surfaces or soft fibers receive close attention when material is the message.
principles.application: Choose lighting, scale and background that reveal the particular property instead of applying one glossy finish everywhere.
principles.exception: Airbnb deliberately mixes material families; OpenAI often communicates through flat geometry. Dimensional realism is not universal.

evidence.description: Broad blue and green surfaces give way to close relief of the lock-screen numerals. The object is initially read as material before it is read as interface.
The rounded lens travels across the same paragraph. Enlarged text and distortion at its edge make a small optical behavior the subject.
Dark close-ups of edges and a changing rounded silhouette lead to a pale translucent Liquid Glass title. The restrained object and light study is one material-introduction beat.
Slider, switch, tab selection, camera mode control and slide-to-answer reuse rounded translucent forms. Many subjects are short examples of the same control-material claim.
Leather-looking strips wrap the suitcase outline, the object resolves, the shot inspects stitching, and decorative stickers arrive. Several cuts deepen one icon rather than introducing new scenes.
Gem, furry paw and bed expand the material vocabulary. A progression from tiny symbol to furnished room then enters a listing-editor interface.
Light and dark material samples remain above aerial ocean imagery, demonstrating different readable surface treatments. The next join is our edit.

The opening blue-green landscape resolves into enormously enlarged transparent clock numerals. Near edges have bright relief while farther regions soften; the interface is temporarily treated as a material object.
Colorful Photos petals and a Safari needle receive dimensional macro treatment before the dock and complete phone restore usable scale.
A nearly black field makes a glass silhouette readable at its rim; the name then appears as pale dimensional lettering on a pale field. Both treatments minimize competing objects.
Sliders and rounded controls are removed from the device and placed on a pale stage. The same rounded language subsequently sits over camera and call imagery.
Playback controls remain recognizable over floral artwork and a strongly green album background. Clock numerals are then enlarged and returned to the phone.

The dock is shown as a broad gray translucent strip against Yosemite scenery. Icons retain individual illustration styles, including paper, metallic discs, a stamp, leather-like contact book and simple speech bubbles.

The suitcase moves from line-symbol logic into a dimensional object with pink-brown leather grain, thread loops, brass-colored rivets and stickers. A close crop gives the stitching its own product shot.

principles.title: Overlap the arrival with the departure when the relationship matters
principles.observation: The next subject begins to establish itself before the preceding composition has fully disappeared.
principles.application: Use the overlap to reveal containment, shared color, assembly or another concrete relationship.
principles.exception: Overlap can confuse the focal point. Plain cuts are used when the new subject does not need a prolonged explanation.

evidence.description: The enlarged black corner resolves into the Next button as the view pulls back and surrounding profile content fades into place.

Leather strips fold around the still-visible white suitcase outline; the grid disappears and the background lightens. The object persists, but the final semantic map treats the move from line icons to the suitcase material study as a chapter change.
The chosen bed/room illustration remains while the other detail levels fade and the listing editor appears around it. The abstract system lands in use.
Large swatch bands rise from the bottom while the UI remains visible above, then expand into a multi-column palette. New subject occupies the frame before the previous one is fully gone.
Avatar circles separate from a row and travel into different conversation rows as Messages content appears behind them.
Material swatches arrive over the still-visible Messages UI; ocean imagery then replaces the app beneath them. The surface cards bridge the background change.

The view targets a purple file-tag dot; surrounding Finder content moves away as a portrait grows inside that same circle and Messages rows emerge. Shared circular geometry makes the app change legible.
The view travels right: Messages leaves to the left while the dark widget surface enters from the right, followed by calendar event construction.
Widget panel slides right, revealing wallpaper and Calendar on the left. The motion hands back to the desktop and additional windows accumulate.
Finished editorial covers arrive one by one over the still-visible grid. The underlying rule becomes a collage of results without first clearing the frame.

principles.title: Use silhouette, outline and overlap as alternatives to modeled depth
principles.observation: Crisp shape contrast, fine lines and occlusion separate elements in flat icon, UI and editorial compositions.
principles.application: Choose the simplest separation cue that makes the relationship visible.
principles.exception: Flat contrast does not forbid texture or dimensional passages elsewhere in the same film.

evidence.description: The control study becomes a run of black line glyphs on white. Consistent stroke character links several symbols without any device or surface rendering.
White line icons occupy an ochre field with a darker square grid. Stroke width, proportions and alignment can be compared without changing the staging.

A black dot becomes rings and a varied dot population on a large white field. Small peripheral labels and the principles list remain secondary. Color arrives as a controlled variation of the same elementary shape.
Large outlines, circles, tangents and vector handles explain letter contours; black filled glyphs then appear alongside their outline versions.
The typeface is shown as dense character coverage, an enlarged lowercase a, a weight ladder and multiple scripts. Diagram detail and bold editorial scale coexist without device chrome.
Large flat color circles become a grouped palette and then smaller dispersed dots. Their consistent geometry lets hue and population change without adding texture or shading.

Photography alternates among full-bleed landscapes, white-bordered images and asymmetrically paired crops. Distributed white text sometimes sits directly in the landscape; these are brand-image compositions, not device mockups.

Research covers, typographic specimens and photography accumulate into an overlapping editorial collage. Saturated yellow, orange, blue and image texture enter together, while clean rectangular edges keep their identities.

principles.title: Change viewpoint on a cut when continuity of travel is unnecessary
principles.observation: Some detail sequences switch framing or angle directly, continuing the subject through editorial comparison.
principles.application: Pair useful views instead of requiring a continuous animated path between every two compositions.
principles.exception: Only original-source boundaries support editorial conclusions; joins introduced in our selected reels are excluded.

evidence.description: An extreme oblique glass-numeral detail drifts gently, then cuts to a wider 9:41 construction. The wider shot continues a quiet lateral relative move; the depth and optical edges remain the subject.

A narrow oblique product crop drifts, then a cut changes to a much closer and more frontal icon grid. The second shot reveals higher icon rows through a slow vertical survey.

The suitcase is assembled in a centered product frame. A cut reveals stitching at extreme close range, where the threads animate but the framing is essentially held; another cut returns to the finished suitcase.

The suitcase, gem, paw and bed occupy similar central product space across cuts. Several rotate subtly relative to the viewer. The bed then reduces into a row of increasingly detailed representations.

An upright component collection cuts to oblique dimensional sample tiles. The tiles drift upward relative to frame before a white signature replaces them. Flat application and dimensional material presentation are deliberately distinct.

Photos petals cut to a Safari needle in a similar oversized material-study scale. The needle/compass resolves into its icon as the relative orientation levels and surrounding Dock appears. It is a combined object assembly and viewpoint change, not camera motion alone.

principles.application: Choose separation, overlap or surface contrast according to the relationship being explained; an exploded view is one option.
principles.exception: Depth is not automatically hierarchy. An arbitrary pile of panels is a different visual effect.

principles.application: Restore the device at a meaningful context beat; use close crops or isolated UI when the hardware adds little.
principles.exception: This occurs in three films but only one brand. Airbnb and OpenAI demonstrate strong alternatives without modeled hardware.

principles.application: Choose a start and end view that each explain something; let rotation connect them.
principles.exception: Do not label this a proven camera orbit: object rotation and camera orbit can produce similar screen motion.

principles.title: Prepare some cuts with a change of scale or motion

principles.application: Use the outgoing motion to establish where attention should land after the cut.
principles.exception: Not every cut needs anticipation. A sharp unprepared cut can be appropriate punctuation.

evidence.description: The view accelerates toward the small back arrow. A hard change to yellow preserves the enlarged white arrow near the same screen location; the grid then expands around it.

principles.title: Use soft shadows where low-contrast surfaces need separation
principles.observation: White cards, UI planes and some icons are gently separated from pale surroundings with diffuse shadows.
principles.application: Let shadow strength follow the separation problem and implied distance.
principles.exception: OpenAI often achieves stacking through overlap and contrast. Shadows are an option, not a universal polish requirement.

principles.title: Separate the main displacement from the settling tail
principles.observation: In the measured sample, most of the travel or growth often happens before the selected interval is halfway over, followed by a slower residual change.
principles.application: Judge pace by both the main move and the arrival, rather than total duration alone.
principles.exception: Airbnb's vertical chip motion is S-shaped. The sample covers three films and does not establish a universal default curve.

Frame1 is invisible/undetected and zero is an inferred threshold baseline. Frame2 is first measured feature. start+1/end-unchanged sensitivity excludes this inferred baseline.
Apparent screen diameter may combine object scale and camera change. Not a recovered world-space camera curve.
Same physical feature as airbnb-chip-y; not an independent event. Integer-pixel position.

principles.title: Use the outgoing direction to organize the next entrance
principles.observation: A sweep, push or replacement passes attention along a shared visual direction.
principles.application: Inspect a move as a pair with its neighbor, not only as a pleasing isolated animation.
principles.exception: Direction changes can punctuate a new idea. Coherent rhythm does not require unbroken travel in one direction.

principles.observation: Some sequences move between oblique dimensional views and frontal diagrams or readable product views.
principles.application: Use the change in viewing mode to mark a change from material/form inspection to reading or system context.
principles.exception: These are visible viewing modes; exact projection matrices and focal lengths are unknown.

principles.application: Make the angle reveal a relationship that a frontal view hides.

principles.observation: Selected iOS 7 and Yosemite passages survey adjacent interface or icon details rather than only enlarging them.

The same rightward survey continues through media, store and utility icons at a readable, nearly constant scale, then accelerates into a close transition near the end.

principles.application: Link the aperture to a shape already meaningful in the outgoing composition.
